About Thinklens

Senior consultants,
on demand.

Thinklens is a Hyderabad-based remote IT consulting team that gives staffing agencies, freelancers, HR partners, and businesses senior Data, BI, and IT expertise exactly when they need it — long-term, short-term, or overflow, on short notice. Data & BI is our core; we also handle project support, ongoing support, and training. For agencies, we can deliver silently under your MSA.

How we got here

Built on what
the market was missing.

Thinklens was founded in 2025 after years of watching teams struggle to get senior data and IT expertise fast enough. Agencies absorbed the cost of building a bench; freelancers turned down work they couldn't cover alone; businesses waited out long hiring cycles for help they needed in weeks. Every gap showed up downstream — in cleanup work, missed deadlines, or churn.

We built Thinklens to be the answer to that gap: a senior team you can switch on for a sprint or a year. For staffing agencies we plug into your MSA without competing for the client; for freelancers we're a second pair of senior hands; for businesses we're expertise without the headcount. Our consultants are vetted for Fortune 500-grade rigor in data governance, ETL testing, BI, and SAP/Workday data work — plus the project support, ongoing support, and training that keep it all running.

We don't try to be everything. We make sure the work you need delivered gets staffed, delivered, and signed off — on time, on spec, and at the technical depth your client expects — then we step back.

What we built our practice on

Disciplines, not
buzzwords.

Data & BI is our core specialty — consultants selected for depth across these four tracks, backed by a senior bench pre-vetted on real Fortune 500 work. Around it we add project support, ongoing support, and training.

Track 01

Data Governance & Technical BA

Requirements analysis, data stewardship, master data design, and source-system documentation for Fortune 500 implementations across SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP MM, and Workday Data.

Track 02

BI & ETL Modernization

Power BI, Tableau, and TIBCO Spotfire delivery — dashboard development, report modernization, semantic modeling, and performance tuning at enterprise scale.

Track 03

ETL Testing & Report QA

End-to-end pipeline validation, source-to-target reconciliation, regression suites, and BI report quality assurance against Power BI, Tableau, and Spotfire — typically 95%+ test coverage before sign-off.

Track 04

Data Quality, Analysis & Cleanup

SQL-heavy data analysis, deduplication, schema remediation, and audit work for messy enterprise datasets. The "boring middle" that makes downstream BI actually trustworthy.

Every engagement is led by a senior consultant with direct Fortune 500 delivery experience. We don't bench-warm juniors — every CV that reaches you has shipped real production work in their primary discipline.
